subject: Project update before Friday
text:
Hey,

Quick update before we lose our minds. The slide deck is finally done. I think it looks sharp. The charts read well. I also cleaned up the sources, so the bibliography is not embarrassing anymore. We are in good shape.

Here is the hiccup. The professor just said our group has to present second, not third. That moved us up by half an hour. I know you were counting on the later slot because you have that dentist thing. I am not thrilled either. I just got the email and nearly dropped my coffee.

I want to help make it work. If you need to leave early, I can run the opening. If you want to stay, you can handle the market section like we planned. We can practice once more tonight. Even ten minutes would help. I can send my notes in a plain text file so your tablet loads them faster.

Also, the printer on the second floor is jammed. I know, classic. Bring a thumb drive just in case. If all else fails, I will wing the transition like some kind of academic stunt coordinator.

Anyway, I have not gone down on this project yet. We are too close. Let me know whether the new time wrecks your afternoon. I can cover more if needed. You helped me last month, so I owe you one. Or several.

Talk soon,
